topic: Internet Stories ep.3: lost domains. google.com bought for $12 via Google Domains by a former Google employee (Sept 2015, owned ~1 min, $6,006.13 reward spells 'Google', doubled when donated to charity) + Microsoft forgot to renew passport.com (Dec 1999, Hotmail partly broken, a programmer paid the $35 fee). Lesson: turn on auto-renew.
caption:
Someone bought google.com for $12. 🤯
And Microsoft once forgot to renew a domain that Hotmail needed to work.
